corrections.after: Hai vợ chồng nhận chăm sóc hai em nhỏ là anh chị em của nhau trong khi một nơi ở lâu dài hơn được thu xếp.
corrections.before: Hai vợ chồng nhận chăm sóc hai anh em trong khi một nơi ở lâu dài hơn được thu xếp.
corrections.reason: Avoid adding the unspecified siblings gender in Vietnamese.
Apply proper month display capitalization without changing the frozen normalized key.

corrections.after: Transitive wreck something; also figuratively wreck a plan. Wrecked is the regular past form.
corrections.before: Transitive wreck something; also figuratively wreck a plan. This manuscript proposes the supplied verb, not an unsupported noun.
corrections.reason: Replace internal manuscript commentary with learner-facing inflection guidance.

corrections.after: Dàn nhạc chỉnh cao độ các nhạc cụ trước khi khán giả vào.
corrections.before: Dàn nhạc chỉnh dây và âm thanh của các nhạc cụ trước khi khán giả vào.
corrections.reason: Translate tuning accurately without adding strings to every instrument.

corrections.after: The librarian left the trolley at the end of the history-book aisle.
corrections.before: The librarian left the trolley beside the aisle of history books.
corrections.reason: Use a natural library aisle collocation and clear location.

corrections.after: Thủ thư để xe đẩy ở cuối lối đi giữa các kệ sách lịch sử.
corrections.before: Thủ thư để xe đẩy bên cạnh lối đi giữa các kệ sách lịch sử.
corrections.reason: Keep the Vietnamese example aligned with the revised end-of-aisle location.

corrections.after: Happening before the usual or expected time, or during the first part of a period.
corrections.before: Happening before the usual, expected, or main time.
corrections.reason: Replace vague main time with precise temporal guidance while retaining early-stage usage.

corrections.after: Transitive cultivate land or a crop; cultivate land for growing something identifies its purpose. Cultivation is the related noun.
corrections.before: Transitive cultivate land or a crop; cultivating and cultivation retain the t in the final syllable.
corrections.reason: Remove misleading final-syllable spelling commentary and add reusable purpose guidance.

corrections.after: Bookbinding is a craft that requires patience and precision.
corrections.before: Bookbinding is a craft that rewards patience and precision.
corrections.reason: Align English requires with the original Vietnamese đòi hỏi rather than mistranslating rewards.

corrections.after: Collective term for equipment; individual items are electronic devices. Common constructions include consumer electronics and electronics repair.
corrections.before: Collective term for equipment; individual items are electronic devices. The final s does not make electronic an adjective ending in s.
corrections.reason: Replace unhelpful final-s commentary with learner-relevant collocations.

corrections.after: năng lực; khả năng thực hiện công việc đạt yêu cầu
corrections.before: năng lực; khả năng thực hiện thành thạo
corrections.reason: Avoid overstating adequate competence as mastery.

corrections.after: Người giám sát đánh giá năng lực của cô trong việc xử lý các câu hỏi của khách hàng.
corrections.before: Người giám sát đánh giá năng lực xử lý các yêu cầu của khách hàng của cô.
corrections.reason: Translate customer enquiries as questions, keeping the ability assessment explicit.

corrections.after: The long-term removal of forest from land that is changed to a non-forest use.
corrections.before: The removal of forest trees from an area, leaving less forest there.
corrections.reason: Distinguish deforestation from temporary tree harvesting after comparison with FAO land-use terminology.

corrections.after: Uncountable; deforestation of an area. Distinguish conversion to non-forest use from temporary harvesting followed by forest regrowth.
corrections.before: Uncountable; deforestation of an area or caused by an activity. This names forest loss rather than ordinary pruning.
corrections.reason: Clarify the land-use boundary rather than treating every decrease in tree cover as deforestation.
